title: 第13章 金瞳术第14章 开启治疗神通
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
陈阳心中暗自震撼。
没想到对方来头这么大，看来今天的事没那么简单。
三人沿着走廊快步前行，很快来到一部专属电梯前。
西装女刷了卡，电梯门缓缓打开。
三人走进去后，电梯径直朝着六楼升去。
电梯门打开，映入眼帘的是一条比五楼更显奢华的走廊。
墙壁上挂着名贵的油画，地毯厚实得几乎听不到脚步声。
走到一间厚重的实木房门前，西装女停下脚步，对陈阳做了个“请”的手势：“陈先生，请进。”
陈阳深吸一口气，推门走了进去。
孙雪儿正要跟着进去，却被门口站着的两名身材魁梧的男门卫拦住了去路。
两名门卫面无表情，眼神凌厉，气场十足。
西装女回头看了孙雪儿一眼，语气依旧冰冷：“孙小姐，请你在门外稍等片刻。”
说完，不等孙雪儿回应，就反手关上了房门。
一进房内，陈阳就发现这是一间宽敞奢华的会客厅。
面积足有上百平米，装修得古色古香又不失尊贵。
地上铺着价值不菲的波斯地毯，墙壁上挂着名家字画，角落里摆放着精致的古董摆件。
房间中央摆放着一套红木沙发，沙发上坐着一名身穿月白色旗袍的女子。
女子约莫二十三四岁的年纪，身形窈窕，旗袍勾勒出她玲珑有致的曲线。
她的皮肤白皙如玉，五官精致绝美，气质温婉又带着一丝与生俱来的高贵，宛如从画中走出来的古典美人。
西装女走上前，恭敬地介绍道：“小姐，陈先生到了。”

她随即又转向陈阳，介绍道：“陈先生，这位正是我们小姐，何清瑶女士。”
何清瑶连忙从沙发上站起身，脸上带着热切的笑容，快步走上前来，主动伸出手：“陈大师，很高兴见到你！”
“陈大师？”陈阳愣住了，脸上满是意外，伸手与她手轻轻握了一下，触手微凉。
他疑惑说，“何小姐，你是不是认错人了？”
“我只是个普通人，可不是什么大师。”
“陈大师，我找的正是你，绝对不会认错。”何清瑶语气笃定。
说着，她拿出自己的手机，点开一个监控视频，递到陈阳面前，“你看这个。”
陈阳低头看向手机屏幕，瞳孔瞬间收缩。
视频画面正是刚才他在赌桌押注的场景，镜头精准地对准了他的脸。
当荷官摇盅后，画面里的他双眼明显闪过一丝奇异的亮光，虽然只是短暂的一瞬，却被拍得清清楚楚。
陈阳心中一沉。
他刚才在赌桌时就特意提防周围的摄像头，没想到还是被拍了下来。
从拍摄角度来看，这监控摄像头显然藏在荷官的手表里，难怪能拍到他眼部细节。
他强压下心中的慌乱，冷静问：“何小姐，你找我有什么事？”
对方既然发现了他的异常，不会是想让他把赢的钱吐出来吧？
何清瑶收起手机，脸上的笑容依旧热切，语气诚恳说：“陈大师，我找你，是想请你帮个忙。”
陈阳高悬的心瞬间落了下来，暗自松了口气。
content_en:
Chen Yang was secretly shocked.
I didn't expect that the other party had such a big background. It seems that today's matter is not that simple.
The three of them walked quickly along the corridor and soon came to an exclusive elevator.
The woman in a suit swiped her card and the elevator door slowly opened.
After the three of them walked in, the elevator went straight up to the sixth floor.
The elevator door opened, and what came into view was a corridor that was even more luxurious than the one on the fifth floor.
Expensive oil paintings hung on the walls, and the carpet was so thick that you could barely hear your footsteps.
Walking to the door of a heavy solid wood room, the woman in a suit stopped and made an "please" gesture to Chen Yang: "Mr. Chen, please come in."
Chen Yang took a deep breath, opened the door and walked in.
Sun Xueer was about to follow her in, but was blocked by two burly male guards standing at the door.
The two doormen had expressionless faces, sharp eyes, and full of aura.
The woman in a suit looked back at Sun Xueer, her tone still cold: "Miss Sun, please wait outside the door for a moment."
After saying that, without waiting for a response, Sun Xueer closed the door behind her back.
As soon as he entered the room, Chen Yang found that it was a spacious and luxurious living room.
It covers an area of ​​hundreds of square meters and is decorated in an antique yet noble style.
The floor is covered with valuable Persian carpets, famous calligraphy and paintings are hung on the walls, and exquisite antiques are placed in the corners.
There is a set of mahogany sofas placed in the center of the room. Sitting on the sofa is a woman wearing a moon-white cheongsam.
The woman is about 23 or 24 years old, with a slim figure, and her cheongsam outlines her exquisite curves.
Her skin is as fair as jade, her facial features are exquisite and beautiful, her temperament is gentle and has a hint of innate nobility, like a classical beauty coming out of a painting.
The woman in a suit stepped forward and introduced respectfully: "Miss, Mr. Chen is here."
She then turned to Chen Yang and introduced: "Mr. Chen, this is our young lady, Ms. He Qingyao."
He Qingyao quickly stood up from the sofa, with an eager smile on her face, walked up quickly, and reached out her hand: "Master Chen, nice to see you!"
"Master Chen?" Chen Yang was stunned, with surprise on his face. He stretched out his hand and shook her hand gently, feeling a slight chill on his touch.
He said doubtfully, "Miss He, did you admit the wrong person?"
"I'm just an ordinary person, not a master."
"Master Chen, it's you I'm looking for. I will never admit your mistake." He Qingyao said firmly.
As she said that, she took out her mobile phone, clicked on a surveillance video, and handed it to Chen Yang, "Look at this."
Chen Yang lowered his head to look at the screen of his phone, his pupils shrinking instantly.
The video picture was exactly the scene where he was placing bets at the gambling table just now, and the camera was accurately focused on his face.
When the croupier shook the cup, his eyes clearly flashed with a strange light in the picture. Although it was only a brief moment, it was clearly captured.
Chen Yang's heart sank.
When he was at the gambling table just now, he was deliberately wary of the cameras around him, but he didn't expect to be photographed anyway.
From the shooting point of view, this surveillance camera is obviously hidden in the dealer's watch. No wonder it can capture the details of his eyes.
He suppressed the panic in his heart and asked calmly: "Miss He, what do you want from me?"
Now that the other party discovered his anomaly, wouldn't they want him to spit out the money he won?
He Qingyao put away her phone, with the smile still eager on her face, and said in a sincere tone: "Master Chen, I'm looking for you because I want to ask you for a favor."
Chen Yang's heart suddenly dropped, and he secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
